status: Illustrative planning hypotheses for validation, not customer interview findings

personas.startingPoint: Notices tired-looking skin after busy weeks and wants to know which everyday care steps matter.

stages.question: What could help me care for my skin over time?
stages.action: Understand the role of daily sun protection and realistic timelines.

stages.question: What should I do before sunscreen, and how much do I apply?
stages.action: Check preparation, application amount, morning order and reapplication.

stages.question: Will it feel comfortable under makeup?
stages.action: Review the finish and build a manageable daily routine.

stages.question: What will it cost, and how do I order?
stages.action: Check the full order details and follow the Shopee link for the 50ml option.

afterPurchase.question: How do I keep the routine going?
afterPurchase.action: Follow the application guide and use the optional tracker or calendar reminder.

personas.startingPoint: Already wants daily sunscreen and compares ingredients, finish, price and suitability before choosing.

stages.question: How does this sunscreen compare with my other options?
stages.action: Compare protection, texture, product size, activity needs and cost.

stages.question: Will the formula fit my skin and existing routine?
stages.action: Read the full ingredient reference and suitability guidance.

stages.question: Can I explore the texture before opening the full-size tube?
stages.action: Read the sample-first process and sealed-product return conditions.

stages.question: Do the price and conditions work for me?
stages.action: Confirm the selected item and full order total before paying on Shopee.

afterPurchase.question: How should I introduce a new product?
afterPurchase.action: Follow new-product testing and packaging directions, keeping the full-size tube sealed while trying the sachets.

personas.startingPoint: Wants a skincare gift and compares presentation, usefulness, price and delivery.

stages.question: Which gift fits the person and my budget?
stages.action: Browse by budget and consider the recipient’s preferences.

stages.question: Should I choose one product or the Duo?
stages.action: Compare the separate protection and hydration roles, contents and prices.

stages.question: What is included, and when will it arrive?
stages.action: Check gift presentation, included extras, ingredient preferences and delivery information.

stages.question: How do I order the right items?
stages.action: Open the relevant Shopee listings and confirm the complete order.

afterPurchase.question: How can the recipient get started?
afterPurchase.action: Track the order and share the application guide and care resources.
